verdict.rationale: Bolna provides extraction-categories API to attach custom entity/data extraction to agents and a call_summary_enabled toggle for summaries, plus transcript fetch via API — covering entities, summaries, and outcomes. However, there's no explicit documentation of a unified structured 'disposition' field, no clear webhook delivery mechanism for post-call structured payloads (only API fetch is shown), and no example of the combined extraction+summary+disposition JSON schema. missing for 10: webhook-based delivery of extraction results, documented disposition/outcome field, end-to-end example combining all three data types in one payload.
